article.title: How Earthquake Early Warning Systems Work

paragraphs.en: Earthquake early warning systems cannot predict when an earthquake will begin. Instead, they detect shaking after a rupture starts and try to alert people before stronger waves arrive. This distinction is essential for understanding both their value and limitations. Energy travels outward from an earthquake source as seismic waves. Primary waves, known as P waves, usually travel faster than secondary waves and many surface waves. Sensors near the source detect early motion, and computers estimate where shaking may occur. Depending on distance and system performance, some people receive several seconds of warning while others receive none at all.
paragraphs.zh: 地震預警不能預測地震何時開始，而是在破裂發生後偵測，嘗試在強震波抵達前通知民眾。地震能量以地震波傳播，P 波通常比 S 波及許多表面波快。震源附近感測器偵測初動，電腦估計可能搖晃的地區。依距離和系統性能，有些人可獲得數秒預警，有些人完全沒有。
paragraphs.ja: 緊急地震速報は発生前の予知ではなく、発生後に速いP波を検知し、強い揺れが届く前に知らせます。震源との距離によっては数秒の猶予がありますが、間に合わない場合もあります。

paragraphs.en: A network of seismometers continuously monitors ground motion. When multiple instruments register signals consistent with an earthquake, algorithms estimate the location, magnitude, and expected shaking intensity. These calculations must happen quickly, but not every vibration comes from an earthquake. Traffic, construction work, and equipment faults can produce misleading signals. Waiting for additional measurements improves confidence while consuming valuable time. Sending an alert too soon may produce an inaccurate estimate. Engineers therefore test their systems using past earthquakes, simulated events, and different patterns of sensor failure. They must choose thresholds that balance speed, missed events, and false alarms.
paragraphs.zh: 地震儀網路持續監測地面運動。多個儀器偵測到符合地震的訊號後，演算法估計位置、規模與震度。交通、施工和設備故障也可能產生誤導訊號。等待更多資料提高可信度，卻消耗時間；過早警報又可能不準。工程師利用歷史地震、模擬事件與感測器故障測試，設定兼顧速度、漏報與誤報的門檻。
paragraphs.ja: 複数の地震計の情報から震源、規模、予想震度を推定します。交通や工事の振動と区別し、過去の地震や模擬データで検証します。警報を早めるほど誤報の危険もあるため、基準の調整が必要です。

paragraphs.en: Alerts may reach people through mobile phones, television, public speakers, or automated control systems. Some trains can slow down, elevators can stop safely, and factories may pause delicate equipment. These actions require careful design because unnecessary shutdowns also carry costs and risks. Public instructions must be short enough to understand under stress. Rather than searching for more information, people may need to protect their heads, move away from falling objects, and follow locally appropriate safety procedures. Regular drills can make these actions more automatic. An accurate alert is useful only when it arrives in time and leads to effective behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 警報可透過手機、電視、廣播或自動控制系統傳達。列車可減速、電梯可安全停靠、工廠可暫停精密設備，但不必要停機也有成本和風險。指示必須簡短易懂，民眾應保護頭部、遠離掉落物並依場所採取安全動作。定期演練可提高反應效率。準確警報只有及時送達並促成有效行動才有用。
paragraphs.ja: 警報は携帯電話や放送、設備制御に届きます。列車の減速や機器停止が可能ですが、不要な停止にもリスクがあります。短い指示と訓練によって、頭を守るなど適切な行動につなげます。

paragraphs.en: The largest limitation is often the blind zone near the earthquake source. Strong shaking can reach nearby communities before an alert is calculated and delivered. Complex ruptures create another challenge. An earthquake may continue spreading along a fault, eventually becoming larger than its first few seconds suggest. Local soil and building conditions also change how strongly people experience shaking. Consequently, a warning cannot guarantee a precise intensity for every street or building. Residents should treat it as a rapidly updated estimate of danger, not a perfect forecast. The absence of a warning must never be interpreted as proof of safety.
paragraphs.zh: 主要限制是震源附近的盲區，強震可能在警報計算和傳送前抵達。複雜斷層破裂也可能持續延伸，最終規模大於初期估計。當地土壤和建築會影響實際震度。因此警報不能保證每條街或每棟樓的精確強度，它是快速更新的危險估計。沒有收到警報也絕不代表安全。
paragraphs.ja: 震源に近い場所では警報が間に合わないことがあります。断層破壊が広がれば初期の規模推定も変わります。地盤や建物で揺れ方は異なり、警報がないことは安全の証明ではありません。

paragraphs.en: Communication infrastructure introduces further uncertainty. An algorithm may detect an earthquake correctly while damaged networks delay delivery. A phone may be switched off, disconnected, or unable to receive the message. Engineers build redundancy into sensors, servers, power supplies, and communication channels. They also examine how alerts behave when many people use networks simultaneously during a disaster. Public agencies need clear responsibility for issuing corrections and explaining false alarms. Trust depends partly on acknowledging limitations rather than promising impossible precision. A technically sophisticated system can still fail if its message never reaches the people who need it.
paragraphs.zh: 通訊設施增加不確定性。演算法可能正確偵測，但受損網路延遲傳送，手機也可能關機或斷線。工程師在感測器、伺服器、電源與通訊管道設置備援，測試災害時大量使用者造成的壅塞。主管機關需明確負責更正警報與解釋誤報。承認限制有助建立信任，因為再先進的系統若訊息無法送達仍會失敗。
paragraphs.ja: 検知が正しくても通信障害で通知が遅れることがあります。センサー、サーバー、電源、通信に冗長性を持たせ、災害時の混雑も試験します。誤報や訂正を説明する責任も重要です。

paragraphs.en: Early warning is only one part of earthquake safety. Strong buildings, secured furniture, emergency supplies, and practiced evacuation plans remain essential. Authorities should evaluate systems using missed earthquakes, false alerts, delivery delays, and evidence of reduced harm, not simply the total number of notifications. Researchers can improve algorithms as new observations become available, but uncertainty will never disappear completely. The broader lesson is that a few seconds can save lives when detection, communication, infrastructure, and human behavior work together. Preparedness matters on days when warnings work and on days when they do not.
paragraphs.zh: 預警只是地震安全的一環。耐震建築、固定家具、緊急物資與演練仍然重要。主管機關應評估漏報、誤報、傳送延遲及減災效果，而非只看通知數量。新資料可改善演算法，但不確定性不會完全消失。只有偵測、通訊、基礎設施與人的行動協調，數秒預警才能救命；無論警報是否正常，平時準備都重要。
paragraphs.ja: 速報だけでなく耐震建築、家具固定、備蓄、避難訓練が必要です。見逃しや誤報、配信遅延、被害軽減を評価します。数秒の猶予が役立つのは技術と人の行動が結びつくときです。
